caption: The drawing is a rectangular textile piece bordered by a thick, pink fringe. Within the inner area, there is a rectangular section with an embroidered scene, surrounded by a narrow line in a darker color. The scene depicts two women facing each other, one on the left and one on the right, both dressed in long purple dresses, each standing under a large green willow tree with drooping branches. In the background above the women, there is a red and yellow star with smaller ornamental shapes nearby. The central area contains a beige, irregularly shaped section with text embroidered in dark thread. At the corners near the base of the willow trees, there are bushes and plants with green, brown, and pink tones, and additional floral details. The background behind the figures, trees, and text is a pale blue and beige, suggesting sky and ground, with the overall needlework creating texture throughout the piece.
title: Mourning Embroidery
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
